criteria.note: wq#1809 despag P1-3: canonical-frame -> UHP response.* translator. class RespTranslator (despag/uhp/translate.py:70) is the one translator every backend shares (PHASE0_WIRING_SPEC.md C.1/RECOMMENDATION step 3): start() (line 116) emits response.created(seq 0)+response.in_progress; feed() (line 220) turns one canonical frame into output_item/content_part/output_text.delta/reasoning_summary/function_call_arguments/function_call_output events via blocks_from_canonical() (line 31) + _handle() (~line 161); complete() (line 226) closes the open item and emits exactly one terminal event (response.completed|incomplete|failed) carrying the full response object, mapping a cancelled turn to response.failed+status:cancelled with partial output retained (line 236-240); fail() (line 241) emits a non-fatal error event always immediately followed by the terminal; usage is built only from a real result-frame usage object (line 209-213), left null otherwise — never a fabricated zero. despag/app.py wires this into POST /v1/responses: _stream_response (despag/app.py:485-515, StreamingResponse with Cache-Control:no-cache/X-Accel-Buffering:no) bridges despag/runner/turn.py's new Turn.on_frame hook (despag/runner/turn.py:64-76 constructor param, 220-221 invoked the instant a frame is appended in the reader loop, no polling) across threads via call_soon_threadsafe into an asyncio.Queue with a 20s keep-alive; _finish_events (despag/app.py:282-309) / _response_view (despag/app.py:312-328) replay the SAME translator for the blocking/background/polled paths, so stream and non-stream agree on the result shape by construction (streaming.md S-08) and a terminal response is cached once (_finish_events' rec['_final']) so a second read never mints fresh random item ids for the same frames. Unit tests: python3 -m pytest despag/tests/test_translate.py despag/tests/test_uhp.py -> 14 + 57 = 71 passed (test_translate.py is new, 14 cases covering gapless sequencing, text/reasoning/tool_use/tool_result events, usage null-vs-real, cancelled terminal shape, fail() pairing, and stream/non-stream assembly parity; test_uhp.py adds 3 streaming HTTP-level cases against a fake claude backend, replacing the now-obsolete test_streaming_responses_not_implemented). Full suite: python3 -m pytest despag/tests/ -> 120 passed, 0 failed. Live conformance (ACCEPTANCE): python3 -m uhp_conformance.cli --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8790 --class core --harness-id chrn_litellm-mechanical --plain --json despag/reports/p1-3_core_litellm.json -> 40/40 PASS, conformant=true; then once against --harness-id chrn_claude-max --model claude-sonnet-5 --json despag/reports/p1-3_core_claudemax.json -> 40/40 PASS, conformant=true. Both committed. Note: the ticket text's `--harness-id litellm-mechanical`/`claude-max` (bare names) do not match despag's chrn_-prefixed harness ids; uhp_conformance's _harness() silently falls back to the FIRST harness (claude-max) rather than erroring on a non-matching id — confirmed live (T-03 reported model=claude-sonnet-5 under the bare litellm-mechanical flag before the fix) and substituted the real chrn_-prefixed ids instead (same precedent as wq#1858's M-0x -> actual check-id fix). Also fixed a real pre-existing bug this surfaced: despag/app.py's _litellm_healthy() (despag/app.py:55-60, 110-126) probed plain /health (401 unauthenticated, or 15s+/hung when given a bearer — it runs a deep per-deployment check) instead of the proxy's fast /health/liveliness, which made every litellm-mechanical model report unavailable regardless of the translator; both findings logged as ISSUE-LOG candidates #364/#365 in this session's done-notes (direct Edit of kb/ISSUE-LOG.md is guard-blocked from this worktree, primary tree, per wq#1719/wq#900 — a kb-lane ticket should port them in, same gap wq#1858 hit).
